title: MAPCap: A fast and quantitative transcription start site profiling protocol
protocol: Reverse transcribe 1 μg of ERCC RNA Spike-In Mix with random hexamers using SSIII according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Top-up the reverse transcription reaction to a final volume of 50 µl with RNase-free water.
Perform PCR with approximately 10 ng of reverse-transcribed ERCC spike mix as template.
Clean up the PCR reaction using OCC according to the manufacturer's instructions. Elute in 10 µl of RNase-free water.
Carry out in vitro transcription with 500 ng of template DNA using the T7 FashScribe Transcription Kit according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Clean up the transcription reaction using MEGAclear Transcription Clean-up Kit according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Perform 5’ end capping on the RNA transcripts using the Vaccinia Capping System according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Clean up the capped RNA transcripts using OCC. Elute in 17.5 µl RNase-free water.
Measure the concentration of RNA either by Qubit or Nanodrop.
Prepare the Polyphosphatase master mix.
Add 10x Reaction Buffer 2 µl.
Add RNasin+ 0.5 µl.
Add RNA 5’ Polyphosphatase (20 U/µl) 1 µl.
Add RNA in water 16.5 µl (not more than 10 µg).
Incubate at 37ºC for 30 min.
Clean-up using OCC.
Elute in 16.5 µl RNase-free water.
Prepare the Terminator exonuclease master-mix.
Add 10x Reaction Buffer 2 µl.
Add RNasin+ 0.5 µl.
Add Terminator Exonuclease (1 U/µl) 1 µl.
Add RNA in water 16.5 µl.
Incubate at 30ºC for 60 min.
Clean-up using OCC.
Elute in 10 µl.
Measure the concentration of each spike with Qubit.
Create a master-mix of all 10 spikes as a 2-fold serial dilution.
Take 64 ng from one spike.
Take 32 ng from the second spike.
Continue taking decreasing amounts for subsequent spikes, ending with 0.125 ng from the last spike.
This results in a spike master mix with a concentration of 2.5 ng/µl.
Wash 25 µl of Dynabeads ProteinG slurry magnetic beads per sample with IPP buffer.
Resuspend washed beads in at least 300 µl of IPP buffer.
Add 2.5 µg of anti-m7G antibody to the beads in IPP buffer.
Incubate the antibody and beads mixture at 4°C rotating for at least 1 hour.
Wash the beads three times with IPP buffer.
Resuspend washed beads in IPP buffer.
Make aliquots of 150 µl per sample from resuspended beads.
Design DNA antisense oligos to bind within the first 40 nt of small abundant capped RNAs.
Treat total RNA with designed antisense oligos and RNase H to remove targeted capped RNAs.
Purify resulting capped RNA species using the RNA Clean and Concentrator Kit.
Prepare a master mix containing 4 μl of 10x Terminator buffer, 4 μl AS-oligo mix against sn/snoRNAs (6 µM), and 4 μl AS-oligo mix against rRNAs (4 µM).
Add 12 μl of AS-master mix to each sample.
Incubate the RNA at 70°C for 2 min followed by gradual cooling to 37°C.
Once the samples have reached 37°C, add 1 µl of RNase H (2 U/µl).
Incubate the samples at 37°C for 30 min with interval shaking (30 s on, 120 s off) at 1100 rpm.
Incubate the samples at 70°C for 5 min and put on ice immediately for at least 1 min.
Add 2 µl of 5’ Terminator Exonuclease (1 U/µl).
Incubate for 60 min at 30°C with interval shaking (30 s on, 120 s off) at 1100 rpm.
Clean-up using the RCC Kit according to manufacturer’s instructions with slight modifications.
Prepare an adjusted RNA Binding Buffer as follows: Mix 100 µl Binding Buffer + 50 µl EtOH (>95%).
Elute in 100 µl TE buffer.
Transfer the sample to Micro Snap Cap Tubes (Covaris) for fragmentation.
Use the Covaris E220 Focused Ultrasonicator with the following settings: Duty cycle: 10%, Intensity: 5, Power: 175 W, Cycles/Burst: 200, time: 180 s.
Transfer the sonicated RNA in 100 µl TE buffer to the 150 µl aliquots of antibody coupled beads.
Resuspend the mix and incubate at 4°C for 1-2 hours.
Perform a short spin on the tube containing beads to remove liquid from the lid.
Place the tube on a magnet and wait until the beads are properly bound before removing the solution using a vacuum pump or manual pipetting.
Take the tubes from the magnet after the last washing buffer removal, perform another quick spin in a table centrifuge.
Collect the remaining liquid at the bottom of the tube with a 10 μl pipet after taking the tubes off the magnet.
Remove all excess volume from the wash step before proceeding to resuspend beads in a new reaction mix.
Dispense 20 µl from the wall of the tube where the beads were fixed to elute them.
Repeat dispensing until all beads are off the wall and gently resuspend until the beads are homogeneously in solution.
Wash the beads three times with IPP buffer by adding at least 500 μl of IPP buffer and rotating the beads for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Prepare PNK-MES master mix by adding:
2x PNK-MES Buffer: 10 μl
b-Mercaptoethanol (0.1 M): 1 μl
T4 PNK (10 U/μl): 1 μl
RNasin+ (40 U/µl): 0.5 μl
RNase-free water: 7.5 μl
Resuspend the beads in 20 μl of PNK-MES master mix.
Incubate at 37°C for 30 minutes in a thermocycler with 1100 rpm interval shaking (30 s on / 120 s off).
Wash the beads 3 times with cold IPP buffer.
Prepare Ligation master mix by adding:
10x T4 Ligase Buffer: 2 μl
ATP (1 mM): 2 μl
RNase-free water: 7.5 μl
Add 6 μl of PEG-8000 to the solution and mix by flicking the tube and pipetting until the PEG is properly dissolved.
T4 RNA Ligase 1 (10 U/μl): 1 μl
RNasin+ (40 U/µl): 0.5 μl
Resuspend the beads in 19 μl of Ligation master mix.
Add 1 μl of s-oligo (10 µM) to each sample, mix the beads by flicking followed by a quick spin.
Incubate at 25°C for 1 hour in a thermocycler with 1100 rpm interval shaking (30 s on / 120 s off).
Wash the beads 3 times with cold IPP buffer.
After 2 washes, resuspend one sample with 900 µl cold IPP buffer and transfer to every subsequent sample to combine all samples.
Transfer the combined samples to a new Eppendorf tube.
Prepare the rSAP master mix using:
- IPP buffer: 35 µl
- RNasin+: 1 µl
- rSAP: 4 µl
Resuspend the beads in 40 µl of rSAP master mix and incubate at 37°C for 30 min with 1100 rpm interval shaking (30 s on / 120 s off).
Wash beads 3 times with IPP buffer.
Prepare the ProtK master mix using:
- 2x ProtK Buffer: 50 µl
- 10% SDS: 2 µl
- Proteinase K (20 mg/ml): 10 µl
- RNase-free water: 38 µl
Resuspend the beads in 100 µl of ProtK master mix and incubate at 37°C for 20 min with 1100 rpm interval shaking (30 s on / 120 s off).
Place the tube on the magnet.
Transfer the supernatant to a new tube. Discard the beads at this point.
Clean up using OCC according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Elute in 9 µl of RNase-free water.
Prepare Reverse Transcription master mix using the SuperScript III Kit as follows:
- 10x Buffer: 2 µl
- dNTP (10 mM): 1 µl
- MgCl2 (25 mM): 4 µl
Add the 11 μl Reverse Transcription master mix to the sample.
Incubate for 10 min at 42°C, followed by 10 min at 50°C.
Incubate for 10 min at 55°C and then 10 min at 65°C with interval shaking (30 s on / 120 s off).
Purify the sample using OCC according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Elute the sample with 6.5 μl RNase-free water.
Prepare the Circularization master mix as specified in the protocol.
Add the 4 μl of Circulation master mix and incubate for 1-16 hours at 60°C.
Set up a PCR reaction with 20 μl of 2x NEBNext PCR master mix.
Add 1 μl of universal primer P5 at 10 μM concentration.
Add 1 μl of index primer P3 at 10 μM concentration.
Include 9 μl of circularized cDNA library.
Add 9 μl of RNase-free water to complete the reaction setup.
Initiate PCR program with denaturation at 98 ºC for 30 seconds.
Cycle through 98 ºC for 10 seconds, 65 ºC for 30 seconds, and 72 ºC for 20 seconds as required by the starting amount of cDNA library.
Complete PCR with a final extension at 72 ºC for 5 minutes followed by cooling to 4 ºC.
Equilibrate Ampure XP beads at room temperature for 30 minutes before use.
Add 40 μl (1x ratio) of Ampure beads to the amplified library and mix well.
Incubate the mixture for 5 minutes at room temperature on a magnet until beads are fixed.
Remove 75 μl of liquid carefully without disturbing the beads.
Wash the beads twice with 200 μl of 80% EtOH while maintaining them on the magnet.
Dry the beads at room temperature on the magnetic stand for 5 minutes to avoid over-drying.
Resuspend dried beads in 20 μl of RNase-free water and mix well.
Incubate the mixture again until beads are fixed before removing liquid as described earlier.
Reclaim beads from a new tube after mixing with Ampure beads.
Incubate 5 min at room temperature before placing the tube on a magnet.
Once beads are fixed to the magnet and the solution is clear, remove 35 μl of the liquid.
Wash 2x with 200 μl 80% EtOH without removing the beads from the magnet.
Dry the beads at room temperature while on the magnetic stand for 5 min (do not over-dry).
Resuspend the beads in 13 μl of RNase-free water.
Reclaim beads on a magnet and collect the sample in a new tube.
Proceed with quantification of the DNA concentration using Qubit DNA HS.
Control size distribution using Bioanalyzer/Fragment Analyzer.
Store final libraries at -20°C.
Sequence the library following Illumina guidelines (50-75 bp, paired-end, 6 bp index reads).
